title: Project-Owned Literary Chunk Boundary Challenge Set

provenance.creation_note: Every passage was written specifically for this repository. No third-party or user manuscript text is included.

metric.name: avoidable_first_splits
metric.description: Counts cases where the first chunk misses the declared nearby paragraph or sentence boundary while preserving independent losslessness and maximum-size assertions.

cases.source:
The lamp guttered in the hall.

Mara crossed the landing, counting every locked door behind her.
cases.expected_first_chunk: The lamp guttered in the hall.

cases.source: Without looking back, Mara whispered, “Stay here!” Then she stepped into the rain before he could answer.
cases.expected_first_chunk: Without looking back, Mara whispered, “Stay here!”
